connector.none: no Claude connector for Ghost Genius; http with the header credential

reads.note: GET /v2/company?url=<LinkedIn URL>, one per loop item (batch 1, 2 s apart); onError continueRegularOutput, so an error reply becomes an item

connectorGaps: row_number: n8n's Sheets node adds row_number to every row; a CSV export has none (it follows from the row position)
reads.note: Sheets v4.5 read of gid=0 with a filter ID = $json.id (alwaysOutputData): sheet properties (gid → title), then GET values/'Companies', filtered by n8n; no match gives one empty item, which Is New Company? tests

writeReplies.note: Sheets v4.5 append (defineBelow): sheet properties, the header row (values/Companies!1:1), the sheet's used rows for the next free row (the same reply as the read), then PUT values/Companies!<n>:<n> (write-default answers it). Call order from memory

branches: Filter Valid Companies (strict types, onError continueRegularOutput): '1,204' is not a number, so the condition errors and the item goes out the true output; the 404 and 429 items have no website, so false
Is New Company?: true for GrowthForge (empty sheet) → AI Company Scoring → Add Company to CRM
expect.offline: Set Variables names a field with dots ('Location (find it on : https://www.ghostgenius.fr/…)') and Search Companies reads it as $json['Location (find it on : https://www'].ghostgenius[…], which is undefined: n8n may fail the node on that expression before any request (then every variant stops there). Wait 2s and the 2 s batch/pagination intervals add wall time. The Ghost Genius header credential gets a bench dummy
